transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hi, thank you for calling StarTel Business Solutions, this is Sarah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hey, we’re currently on your 100 Mbps fiber plan, and we're looking to upgrade to something faster. We’ve been growing, and performance is becoming a bit of an issue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great to hear that you’re growing! I’d be happy to help. May I have your business name and account ID to pull up your details?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, it's EdgeWave Technologies. Account ID should be 18372.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Give me a second… Okay, I see your current plan. You’re on our Business Fiber 100 plan with static IP. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yep, that's the one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have a couple of upgrade options. The next tier is 300 Mbps at $269/month, and we also offer a 500 Mbps plan with SLA guarantees and 24x7 NOC support for $429/month. Are you looking for just more speed, or also better support/uptime?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Honestly, uptime is becoming more important. We've had two slowdowns this month and our dev team was blocked. That SLA option sounds interesting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it. The 500 Mbps plan includes 99.95% uptime, proactive monitoring, and a dedicated support line. Plus, we can bundle in VoIP lines or MPLS/VPN if needed. Are you managing voice traffic in-house?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, we use a separate VoIP provider right now. We’ve been thinking about consolidating.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We can provide SIP trunking or managed VoIP — and we often bundle them with data plans at a discount. Would you be open to a quick demo on that?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hmm, maybe. Not urgent, but send me details.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. I’ll email you a comparison sheet. For now, should I quote the 500 Mbps plan with SLA?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, please do that. What’s the contract term?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We offer 12 or 24 months. With 24, you get 1 month free and priority install.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sounds fair. Let’s go with 24 months.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Just to confirm: EdgeWave at your current location, 500 Mbps fiber, 24-month term, SLA package, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Awesome, I’ll send you the order summary and agreement to review. You can sign digitally and we’ll schedule provisioning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Perfect. Appreciate your help, Sarah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: My pleasure! Keep an eye on your inbox. If you have questions, just reply or call me directly. Have a great day!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You too!
